user.title: Ravito
user.description: Ravito address and API token, created in Ravito: Settings › Administration › Home Assistant. Scope « liste » to add and check items, « cuisine » to talk to Chef.

reauth_confirm.title: New Ravito token
reauth_confirm.description: The token was rejected (revoked?). Create a new one in Ravito: Settings › Administration › Home Assistant.

chef.name: Talk to Chef
chef.description: Sends a sentence to Chef, Ravito's cook, and returns the reply to read out (speech). « oui » / « non » answers its proposals.
